name: screecher
title: Screecher
description: Send and receive complete links through nearby audio chirps.
author: lcabraja

commands.name: send
commands.title: Send Link
commands.description: Chirp a complete URL to a nearby device.

commands.name: receive
commands.title: Receive Links
commands.description: Listen continuously for links from nearby devices.

commands.name: copy-web-link
commands.title: Copy Web Link
commands.description: Copy the Screecher website URL to share with another device.

scripts.build: bun run helper && ray build -e dist
